name: matrix
description: Connect enabled Xedoc sessions to private Matrix rooms through OAuth.

commands.name: matrix
commands.description: Manage Matrix bridge status, setup, lifecycle debugging, and help with /matrix.

interface.shortDescription: Connect Xedoc sessions to Matrix with OAuth and dual identities.
interface.longDescription: Matrix creates one private room for each approved Xedoc root session. OAuth signs in an agent identity for model messages and an Element user identity for Xedoc user messages; Element input remains bidirectional without echoing into its source room, and bridge lifecycle and failures are reported to Xedoc.
interface.defaultPrompt: Connect this Xedoc session to Matrix.
